extraction.Name: Millie Prue
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded May 11, 1918 by H. E. Vang
extraction.Buyer: Millie Prue and her husband Oliver Prue conveyed lots 3 and 4 and the south half of the northwest quarter to John T. Lane for $1.00 and other valuable consideration; on February 19, 1920 Millie Prue and her husband conveyed 60 acres on the north side of the remaining quarter section to John T. Henson for a consideration of $2400.00; mortgages given by Millie and Oliver Prue for $1200.00 on August 17, 1918, another on July 10, 1920 for $500.00, another May 29, 1919 for a consideration not shown, and another on the remaining 100 acres given March 8, 1922 for $600.00 with interest at eight per cent due March 1, 1927
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: Tax certificate has been issued against this 100 acres for the year 1927
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612732 issued; lots 3 and 4 and the south half of the northwest quarter and the southeast quarter of section 5, township 39, range 25; receipt for patent signed by allottee January 29, 1918; mortgage on remaining 100 acres apparently still in force as of 1929; husband is Oliver Prue
